name: pixel-office
description: Watch varied Codex subagents work in a live pixel office with 729 three-part appearances, unique desks, time-aware windows, waiting areas, and clock-out animations.

interface.shortDescription: 看子智能体在像素办公室里打工
interface.longDescription: A live pixel-art office that mirrors Codex subagents in real time: workers receive one of 729 compatible three-part appearances, use eight distinct desks, stream output in cloud bubbles, wait in the lounge or pantry after a terminal result, and clock out after 30 minutes. The window follows local time and the boss still shouts motivational(?) slogans.
